name: Gliscor
description: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Mud Bomb
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target. Spike splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This raises the user’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user strikes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.
